query: Consider the Non-Disclosure Agreement between GTL and Inria; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: The obligation of confidentiality will remain until the GTL data are released to public or have fallen into public domain.
rag_answer: Yes. The document states that upon expiration or termination of the Agreement, the user must cease using all GTL Data and return or destroy all originals and copies, with certification. It also states that the obligation of confidentiality will remain until the GTL Data are released to the public or fall into the public domain.
